messages:
maria: Quick triage — audit logging coverage gaps by service. I pulled the latest scan + product requests. Need to (1) agree backlog priority, (2) confirm schema changes for customer-facing events, and (3) decide KMS/AAD integration scope. Short thread to capture decisions.

maria: Current high-level gaps I found: API gateway = missing authz decision logs and request_id correlation; auth service = token revoke + session invalidate not emitted; console = admin role changes and RBAC grant/revoke events are partial; billing = export and invoice-download events missing user_id; runtime = model access / model-version selection not consistently logged. KMS = we don't sign logs or envelope encrypt for private deployments.

kevin: Ack. Can we get a single list with required fields per service? minimal contract should be: event_type, ts, actor, target, request_id, outcome, schema_version. :+1:

samir: runtime note — current llama/runtime kernel path only emits trace_id + model_id on start, not per-inference metadata. We can add per-request logging but perf hit for short-lived requests. Suggest sampling for now.

maria: Good point. For runtime let's add: always log model_id + model_version + request_id + actor when inference > 200 tokens or customer-facing feature. Sample short requests at 1% for now.

alice: Compliance/controls: If we expose customer-facing audit events, we need to validate personally identifying fields are redacted and ensure KMS envelope keys for Private. Also need retention metadata (retention_period) in event payload.

kevin: RE: schema bumps — I propose audit_schema v2 that adds: request_id (uuid), actor.type, actor.id, target.type, target.id, outcome (allowed/denied), request_context.client_ip (optional), and kms_key_id (optional). Backwards compatible: existing strings map to actor.id.

kevin: Example contract snippet:
```json
{
  "event_type": "auth.token.revoked",
  "timestamp": "2025-02-11T14:23:00Z",
  "actor": { "type": "service", "id": "auth" },
  "target": { "type": "user", "id": "u-123" },
  "request_id": "r-9f7a...",
  "outcome": "success",
  "details": { "reason": "password_reset" },
  "audit_schema_version": "v2"
}
```

tess: From product POV — customers ask for exact timestamps + request_id to stitch to their side. Also they want a human-readable event_reason in billing exports for audit. We should avoid leaking raw tokens in details.

ryan: For backlog/prio: I estimate API gateway + auth as 2 sprints (infra + tests), console RBAC events 1 sprint, runtime sampling work 1 sprint, billing exports 1 sprint. KMS integration depends on release schedule for private deploy (may require infra changes).

maria: Proposed priority order for triage board: 1) API gateway authz + request_id (blocker for customer audits), 2) auth token/session revokes, 3) console RBAC full events, 4) billing export event shapes, 5) runtime per-request enhancement (sampling), 6) KMS envelope + detect & redact pipeline. Any objections? :eyes:

alice: No objections. Recommend we add a compliance checklist card per change (PII scan, retention policy, proof of encryption if private).

kevin: I'll open infra tickets and a draft schema PR for audit.v2. Will include JSON Schema + example events + an automated validator.

devops-bot: Created ticket SECU-2024: audit-schema-v2 + SECU-2025: api-gateway-audit-logs — links: https://board.redwood.internal/SECU-2024

maria: Thanks. Action items: kevin (schema PR + validator), samir (runtime sampling plan), ryan (planning estimates), alice (compliance checklist + customer notice draft), tess (product sign-off fields). I'll post a short RFC doc by EOD.

kevin: One more ask — for customer-facing event validation we should expose a /audit/validate endpoint that accepts a sample event and returns pass/fail + error list. Good for partners and private deploy testing. Thoughts?

tess: +1. That will reduce support load. Put it in the API gateway milestone.

maria: Great. I'll convert this thread into triage notes and attach to SECU-2024. If anyone wants to reprioritize, reply here. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
